synopsis: The seventh season of Boku no Hero Academia . Following an all-out battle with the Paranormal Liberation Front, it is difficult for the people of Japan to continue placing faith in their heroes. To combat the combined power of Tomura Shigaraki and All For One, All Might calls for his ally from the West—the strongest woman on the planet, Star and Stripe. However, All For One decides to intercept Star and her fleet to get his hands on her overpowered quirk before she can enter Japanese airspace. Although Endeavor, Hawks, and Best Jeanist are headed to the rendezvous point, Star makes a gamble in the present to save her comrades. (Source: MAL Rewrite) Note: The season was preceded by a 4-episode special titled 'Boku no Hero Academia: Memories' recapping events from the 6th season along with adding a few minutes of new material each episode.

title: Dororo
titleNative: どろろ
synopsis: Dororo, a young orphan thief, meets Hyakkimaru, a powerful ronin. Hyakkimaru's father, a greedy feudal lord, had made a pact with 12 demons, offering his yet-unborn son's body parts in exchange for great power. Thus, Hyakkimaru - who was born without arms, legs, eyes, ears, a nose or a mouth - was abandoned in a river as a baby. Rescued and raised by Dr. Honma, who equips him with artificial limbs and teaches him sword-fighting techniques, Hyakkimaru discovers that each time he slays a demon, a piece of his body is restored. Now, he roams the war-torn countryside in search of demons.

Then an encounter with All Might, the greatest hero of them all gives him a chance to change his destiny… (Source: VIZ Media)

title: The Water Magician
titleNative: 水属性の魔法使い
synopsis: Ryou is delighted to be reincarnated into the fantastical world of Phi, where he thinks he’ll get to live a quiet life learning to use his newfound water magic. Going with the flow here, however, means something very different. Ryou is immediately pitted against the wild lands he winds up in and the slew of deadly monsters that call the remote subcontinent home. You’d think he’d forget about taking it easy when he’s stuck fighting for his life, but lucky for Ryou, he’s naturally optimistic, clever, and blessed with the hidden “Eternal Youth” trait. title: Detective Conan: The Gold-Star Answer

synopsis: Jewelry stores across town are being robbed, but despite the crimes taking place, Conan's friend Ayumi is excited. Conan and the Junior Detective League get assigned to guard Kaneko Jewelry Store, which is rumoured to be their next target. After tailing a suspicious customer and discovering the date of the crime, as well as their hideout, the police seem to round up the thieves - but Ayumi notices something odd... Can the Detective League solve the mystery with a cute twist?! (Source: Official website, translated, edited) Note: Special commemorative crossover episode between Detective Conan and Star Detective Precure! for the 30th anniversary of the Detective Conan series.
